# BUG-068 probe: how Drizzle 0.30.10 + postgres.js 3.4.9 store a jsonb object (scratch PostgreSQL 16.15, 2026-10-19)

Generated by `scripts/poc-event-insight/probe-jsonb-encoding.ts`. "string" means the object was stored as JSON text inside a jsonb string (what production shows).

```
default (prepare: true)            | drizzle jsonb: string  | text param ::jsonb: string  | client.json(): object

prepare: true + json passthrough   | drizzle jsonb: object  | text param ::jsonb: object  | client.json(): n/a
prepare: false + json passthrough  | drizzle jsonb: object  | text param ::jsonb: object  | client.json(): n/a
```
